title: Oligarchy is worse than you think
publisher_or_archive: Johnny Harris Media / YouTube Documentary Archive
summary: Investigative documentary examining how modern oligarchy functions in the United States, drawing on the scholarship of Jeffrey Winters and Kimberly Kay Hoang to dissect the 'wealth defense industry', the pivotal 1973 Castle Bank/IRS suppression, and how wealth concentration has doubled over 50 years while insulated from democratic accountability.
